sents.en: Earth is a planet.
Planets travel around stars.
Planets in our solar system orbit the sun.
sents.ko: 우리 태양계의 행성들은 태양 주위를 돌아요.

sents.en: Earth is the third closest planet to the sun.
sents.ko: 지구는 태양에서 세 번째로 가까운 행성이에요.

sents.en: It is about 93 million miles (150 million km) from the sun.
sents.ko: 태양에서 약 9,300만 마일(1억 5천만 km) 떨어져 있어요.

sents.en: Earth orbits the sun every 365 days, that is equal to one year.
sents.ko: 지구는 365일마다 태양을 한 바퀴 도는데, 그것이 1년이에요.

sents.en: Earth spins while it orbits the sun.
sents.ko: 지구는 태양을 도는 동안 스스로 회전해요.

sents.en: One full spin takes 24 hours.
The spin makes day and night.
Earth spins on an axis.
Earth's axis is tilted.
The tilt creates the seasons.
Earth is made of three layers.
sents.ko: 지구는 세 개의 층으로 되어 있어요.

sents.en: They are the core, mantle, and crust.
Water covers 70% of the earth.
Earth has 7 landmasses called continents.
sents.ko: 지구에는 대륙이라고 부르는 큰 땅덩어리가 7개 있어요.

sents.en: Earth's atmosphere is made of gases.
It is made mostly of nitrogen and oxygen.
Living things need these to breathe and live.
sents.ko: 생물은 숨 쉬고 살아가려면 이것들이 필요해요.

sents.en: People, plants, and animals live on Earth.
Oh, yes! Earth is where we live.
sents.ko: 오, 그래요! 지구는 우리가 사는 곳이에요.

sents.en: After reading this book, I think I love Earth even more.
sents.ko: 이 책을 읽고 나니 지구가 더 좋아졌어요.

sents.en: Earth is so beautiful and lovely.
What about you? What do you think now?
Okay. That's all for today. I'll see you next time.
sents.ko: 좋아요. 오늘은 여기까지예요. 다음에 또 만나요.

sents.en: Bye for now!
